scope: Incremental Unicode prop/attribute naming and feature-selected React/Svelte child enrollment. Full ship-ready goal remains active and incomplete.

authority.proposal: https://nextwebwg.org/declarative-components/expressions/: exact identifiers, public prop collisions only under ASCII case folding. No proposal change was needed for this correction.
authority.ownerDirection: Make sure you're not forcing something like forcing components into read children slots when they don't have to
authority.implementationInterpretation: Only an authored as list requires accepted-child enrollment; ordinary projection retains framework children/snippets. Types that can participate in an as list still enroll for hand-written consumers.
authority.approvalStatus: Implementation of the explicit owner direction within the active renderer goal; no new language rule or release authorization inferred.

implementation: Share ASCII-only HTML name folding in parser, contract, runtime, aliases, style resolution and target generation; preserve exact non-ASCII case.
Use the existing identifier-start grammar for component style prop/state selector names, with removable compiler-only patterns.
Allocate distinct discarded React local bindings and emit non-ASCII JSX props as own object keys.
Keep Svelte native elements and existing attribute attachments. A compiler hint and quoted SSR spread preserve affected authored/reflected names without an emitted is attribute.
Select React/Svelte child-entry hooks only when a receiving slot declares as; ordinary projected children keep native DOM identity.

focused.childEnrollment: Observed red true != false for accepts without as, then green; actual React and Svelte client/server compilation.

frameworkBrowser.directAssertions: Independent prop values, distinct data attributes, exact lower/upper CSS selection, update, SSR/hydration and pixel parity. Application/library, five framework targets, three engines.
frameworkBrowser.nestedAssertions: Literal and bound props, delegated root, ordinary projected child without wrapper, retained child identity across updates, native HTMLButtonElement/disabled behavior and no emitted is attribute. Seven targets, development/production, three engines.
frameworkBrowser.finalNestedRun: All 42 scenarios pass together after regenerating the canonical literal reader. No skipped scenario is counted as passed.

nativeNodeOutput.assertions: Exact visible output or carrier contents, removing only known renderer metadata/region markers.

review.method: One bounded inline ce-code-review pass under owner single-agent/cross-model-off guidance

proofBeforeFix.node: é/É fixtures reject HC011; mismatched-case forwarding consumes the wrong prop.
proofBeforeFix.native: Only É is declared, but é was incorrectly consumed through a Unicode-lowercased alias.
proofBeforeFix.frameworks: React duplicate local bindings and invalid quoted JSX attributes; Svelte merges distinct native attribute names.
proofBeforeFix.styles: Resolver maps É to é, then public framework style checks expose the ASCII-only selector grammar.
proofBeforeFix.bundling: Runtime size checks detect compiler pattern initialization retained in generated bundles; compiler initializers are now tree-shaken.

allocations.method: Warmed per-thread allocated bytes, 200 repetitions per core profile; complete outputs validated separately.

costs.sizeLimits: Only these five ceilings increased to the exact measured correctness cost; no extra allowance. All remaining ceilings are unchanged. Generated fixtures exclude interpreter/parser/type-system modules.

remainingQualification: Arbitrary incoming Unicode pass-through names on Svelte roots without affected authored/reflected names and general CSS escape spellings remain unqualified.
Literal invocation/root attribute precedence remains an unanswered owner clarification from the previous unit. No precedence change is made here.
Native styles, accepted-child language, preparation, shared client plan consumption, actual native hydration and full real Looma behavior/hydration across targets remain unfinished.
Complete equivalent Fluid/Node latency, cold/warm throughput and allocated/retained/peak-memory qualification remain unfinished. No package publication or visibility change was performed.
